description: Calculate a monthly mortgage and housing-cost estimate using the buyer's supplied price, down payment, loan term and interest rate. An entered rate is an assumption, not a live lender quote. Review every included cost. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.
